method: For each marked Q1920 class, construct the faithful six-dimensional irreducible F3 module with nonzero fixed space for the first radial S3. Enumerate the exact A-centralizer, retain involutions, impose (ct)^3 and the collision word, and test whether the c-minus eigenspace meets the A-fixed space.
consequence: Only the identity A-central involution satisfies the triangle and collision relations, so no nonzero A-fixed vector can be inverted. The six-dimensional F3 chief-factor escape is impossible.
scope: This exhausts the faithful six-dimensional irreducible modules for both markings. It does not cover dimensions 10, 15, or 24.
